summary:
Revised implementation plan for Oracle-sponsored on-chain pot settlement on Hemi Sepolia:
- Players stake in-app $CRAZY8 chips in the lobby gaslessly (no player wallet approval or gas required).
- The funded backend Oracle relayer manages on-chain execution and pays all gas fees.
- Upon match completion, the Oracle releases 95% of the lobby's pot directly to the winner's wallet address on Hemi Sepolia with a verifiable transaction hash.
- Unstarted lobby exits automatically refund chips instantly without gas.
